text:
marta: Quick sync — inbound from OpenHarbor on their open model listing. Two asks: 1) cloud marketplace listing sequencing (hosted vs BYOW), 2) KMS/provenance guarantees for redistributed weights. Legal + SI + HW need alignment before we schedule announcement.

aj-legal: Need clarity on redistribution clause. If we let BYOW downloads, partner must warrant origin and provide detached signatures or chain-of-custody docs. Also need export compliance checklist.

rebecca-solutions: SI viewpoint: we require a deliverable package for on-prem customers — model tar, manifest, sig, plus optional quant report. For KMS we can support references to CMKs (AWS) or HSM-URNs, but we need rotation policy details.

sahil-product: Proposal: two-track launch. Track A = Hosted listing (API only) — minimal legal friction, list Day 0. Track B = BYOW/download SKU — requires addendum + provenance proof, list after legal sign-off (suggest T+14). This lets marketplace ops and sales start with hosted offering.

marta: Partner says they can provide a provenance manifest and detached PGP signature. They asked whether KMS key rotation during the embargo window would block listing.

aj-legal: Rotation itself isn't a blocker, but the manifest must include key IDs and rotation history (hashes/time). We'll add a warranty: partner confirms manifest integrity and will preserve signing keys audit logs for 12 months. Also require copy of signature verification steps.

rebecca-solutions: Good. For SI integrations we also need a quantization certification if partners claim edge performance. Can we loop in HW SI for a validation run?

tom-hw: I'll ping the HW SI team. They can run a validation on XSeries nodes next Tue/Wed. Will confirm availability and any firmware constraints.

marta: Perfect. Also need announcement cadence: teaser -> partner blog -> joint webinar -> GA. Sales embargo window must be explicit. Who drafts the cadence?

sahil-product: I'll draft a cadence doc. Question: host listing Day 0, BYOW after addendum. Recommend embargo for sales outreach until partner signs addendum (so we avoid BYOW leakage).

rebecca-solutions: Docs action: add an SDK quickstart showing KMS integration (AWS KMS + on-prem HSM example) and a manifest verification snippet. I'll add a stub to docs repo.

aj-legal: I'll prepare the addendum and the specific redistribution paragraph. Send me their example manifest + sample signature.

marta: Pasting a short mock manifest example from partner (they gave this snippet):

```
{
  "model_name": "openharbor-13b",
  "version": "2026-03-01",
  "artifact_digest": "sha256:abc123...",
  "signer": "OpenHarbor Ltd.",
  "signer_key_id": "0xF00DBAAA",
  "signature_type": "pgp-detached",
  "kms_reference": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/aaaa-bbbb-cccc",
  "rotation_history": ["2026-02-01:keyid-0xAAA","2026-02-15:keyid-0xF00D"]
}
```

rebecca-solutions: That looks fine as a starting schema. We'll map fields to our SI packaging spec.

tom-hw: :thumbsup: will coordinate HW test and post results in this thread.

infra-bot: created ticket PARTNERS-4829 for marketplace KMS integration tracking — https://redwood.company/issue/PARTNERS-4829

aj-legal: Once I get the manifest + example signature, I'll draft the addendum and drop for review.

marta: Thanks everyone — next steps: Sahil drafts cadence (due EOD Fri), Aj drafts addendum (draft by Mon), Rebecca preps quickstart stub, Tom confirms HW validation slot. We'll reconvene after those items land.
